note: A modder's request for each subject of the brief legs (rubric.md, amendments of 2026-10-16): what the asset is, what it is for, how it should look, and a size a modder would know because their maps need it. Nothing in them is read off the original's pictures. `asked` is the size held against the build (M2): high, across or long, in units.

filecabinet.brief: a grey steel office filing cabinet, three drawers with handles, a bit grimy, for the offices of my research facility; about 62 tall, 29 deep and 23 wide so it sits where the old one did

battery.brief: a suit battery pickup the player grabs to recharge armour: a chunky grey metal energy cell with glowing green panels, hazard stripes and a stubby handle on top, lying on the floor; about 18 tall and 10 across

medkit.brief: a first aid kit pickup lying flat on the floor: a white case with a red cross, FIRST AID lettering and a carry strap; about 35 long, 26 wide and 7 high

forklift.brief: a warehouse forklift with its driver in the seat, a heavy industrial machine for my loading dock; about 187 long, 60 wide and 113 high

headcrab.brief: a small alien parasite that scuttles on four legs and leaps at your face: a cream-coloured shell over its legs, sharp red front claws, a beak-like mouth underneath; about 26 long and 13 high

crowbar.brief: a red-painted steel crowbar, worn to bare metal at the tips, the player's melee weapon swung in one hand; about 32 long

shotgun.brief: a pump-action combat shotgun, black metal with a wooden or dark pump and stock, the player pumps it between shots; about 30 long

9mmhandgun.brief: a 9mm semi-automatic pistol, black and grey polymer and steel, a standard sidearm held in the right hand, lying on its side on the floor; about 10 long

barney.brief: a security guard NPC for my research facility: a man in a blue uniform shirt and blue-violet trousers, a helmet with a visor and a black bulletproof vest with SECURITY on the back, a pistol holster on his belt; he runs and fights beside the player; about 75 tall

scientist.brief: a scientist NPC: an older man in a white lab coat over a blue shirt and a red tie, light trousers, glasses, balding with grey hair; he walks, runs from danger and follows the player; about 68 tall

zombie.brief: a zombie enemy: a scientist taken over by a parasite, its lab coat torn and bloodied, the parasite's body over its head, long clawed hands, shambling and hunched as it walks and slashes; about 68 tall

houndeye.brief: an alien creature that hunts in packs: a squat yellowish body on three thin legs, one large eye on its front, striped and dappled hide; it runs and charges a sonic blast; about 45 tall and 49 long

seal.brief: a player model for my action mod: a special forces operator in fatigues, a dark tactical vest with pouches, boots, gloves and a balaclava; about 70 tall

merc.brief: a player model for my action mod: a mercenary in a black balaclava, a vest with pouches and cargo trousers, boots, with gear pouches on the belt; about 69 tall

glow01.brief: a soft round white glow put over lamps and lights, fading smoothly to nothing at the edge

flare1.brief: a lens flare for bright lights: a hot white centre in a soft round halo

fire.brief: a looping flame for burning barrels and wreckage: orange and yellow tongues of fire licking upwards

zerogxplode.brief: an explosion: a fireball that bursts, billows out into lobes and burns away to nothing

steam1.brief: a puff of steam from a broken pipe, white and grey, swelling and thinning as it fades

xspark1.brief: a small soft blue-white glow that flickers in place and loops, the light of an electric spark

laserbeam.brief: the texture a laser beam is drawn with across its width: a bright pale core down its length, its grey-blue glow running out to both edges

muzzleflash1.brief: a gun's muzzle flash: a short bright burst of fire in a star shape, two frames

textures.brief: new textures for my deathmatch map, a dark industrial research facility, each in the place of the map's own under its name and size so every wall lines up as before
